roles.title: AI Engineer
roles.tagline: Design, build, and ship products powered by LLMs, agents, and intelligent systems
roles.overview: AI Engineers are the people turning raw models into products people actually use — RAG systems, autonomous agents, and AI features inside existing apps. It is the single fastest-growing job title in the United States, topping LinkedIn's Jobs on the Rise list two years running, and one of the few roles where demand is growing far faster than supply

roles.ctaHeadline: The market is hungry for AI Engineers. Start becoming one today.

roles.title: Machine Learning
roles.tagline: Build, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning systems at production scale
roles.overview: Machine Learning Engineers are the most common AI title in Europe and one of the largest AI hiring categories in the US, with hundreds of new postings every month. The role sits at the intersection of data, models, and infrastructure — if you like productionizing models that reliably work in the real world, this track is where the career runway is longest

roles.overview: The World Economic Forum projects data science to be one of the fastest-growing jobs of the decade, with demand expected to grow over 100% by 2030. Data Scientists are moving beyond reports and into ML and LLM work — the role is being redefined to sit closer to product decisions than ever before

roles.title: Full Stack Developer

roles.overview: Full Stack Developers remain the most consistently requested engineering role in the market, and in 2026 the most in-demand variant combines it with AI: companies are paying a premium for engineers who can wire LLMs into a shipped product end to end. It is the pragmatic path to owning whole systems — from database to button

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.tagline: Build modern, accessible, high-performance web interfaces with React and TypeScript
roles.overview: Frontend development is one of the most accessible doors into tech — roughly one in five openings is entry-level, far above the industry average. Yet senior frontend demand is still scrambling: TypeScript, design systems, and performance skills command a real salary premium, which means frontends who grow past the tutorial stage are scarce

helpSteps.title: Diagnose your frontend level
helpSteps.desc: Start anywhere — AI benchmarks your HTML, CSS, React, and TypeScript and builds a path from your exact baseline to a frontend job

helpSteps.title: Master the modern frontend stack
helpSteps.desc: Your roadmap flows from React fundamentals to Next.js, design systems, and performance — with a polished portfolio project every step of the way

helpSteps.title: Ship UI and get ranked proof
helpSteps.desc: Deploy real interfaces, import them as GitHub proof, and earn verified skill checks that interviewers can actually inspect

helpSteps.title: Win frontend interviews
helpSteps.desc: AI mock interviews on React patterns and system design, plus an ATS resume that highlights your TypeScript premium over the crowd

roles.ctaHeadline: Frontend is the fastest door into tech. TypeScript up and walk through it

roles.title: Backend Developer
roles.tagline: Build APIs, services, databases, and scalable systems that power everything else
roles.overview: Backend engineering is where the highest-paid senior roles in software live — but it is also the least entry-level-friendly track, with barely 1% of postings open to juniors. That mismatch makes structured, proven preparation non-negotiable: the market rewards backend engineers who can show real systems experience over course certificates

helpSteps.title: Diagnose against real hiring bars
helpSteps.desc: AI tests your programming, data modeling, and system-design fundamentals — showing you where companies expect entry-level candidates to actually fail.

helpSteps.title: Build scalable systems step by step
helpSteps.desc: Your roadmap moves from API design to distributed systems, with production-grade projects that become the proofs hiring managers trust

helpSteps.title: Prove production experience
helpSteps.desc: Import your deployments, get AI reviews on architecture, and accumulate verified skill proof that closes the junior-openings gap

helpSteps.title: Command the senior backend market
